_readme: THE CLONE. Full app set, content-free. New client = copy this file to <id>.json, set id/subdomain/brand/crm, copy src/data/_template -> src/data/<id>, register <id> in the seam libs (pricing.js, images.js, brandKit.js, attention.js, signals.js, market-news.js), then npm run validate:clients. See docs/ONBOARDING_AND_AGENTS_SDD.md.
